basic_info.description: This unique, gated entry home located just above West Portal Shopping area and adjacent to Edgehill Mountain Open Space.   An executive home with over 3,500 square feet of living space, the home features 4 bedrooms, a den, and 3.5 baths, along with a 2-car garage.    The main floor includes a spacious living room flows into a formal dining room, a fully equipped chef's kitchen and boasting a wide deck to enjoy the morning sun.    The upper level features a primary bedroom with its own private den/office, an ensuite bath, walk-in closet and a large deck that offers ocean views.  A spacious bedroom with its full shower bath completes this floor.  Each room completes with private decking and storage areas.    Lower floor includes a great room with a fireplace, two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and a laundry room.  There's more, next to the backyard is an unfinished, oversized, bonus space ideal for a workout area or a hangout for teenagers.  Back yard is equipped with a deck, perfect for stargazing nights.         A private community of only 13 homes next to transportation, shopping and Open Space.  An unique opportunity for those seeking a blend of urban convenience and nature within the city's vibrant landscape. Come take a look before it's gone!
